text:
Kevin: Taking over the swing shift — quick handoff below.
- Current incidents: INC-2343 (routing flap in us-west1) causing 5-10s tail latency on hosted text endpoints.
- Mitigations in place: traffic routed to backup pool, spun up +2 router replicas, temporary traffic-weight change for canary.
- KV cache: hit rate recovered to ~92% after eviction tuning; still watching for regressions.
- No confirmed customer 5xx spike right now but p99 latency elevated.

opsbot: ALERT: routing-flap detected in us-west1 at 2026-03-17T18:05Z. Incident ID INC-2343. Link: <https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2343>

Maria: thx — FYI I rolled a small canary change ~1h ago (PR #5324) that reduces long-lived connections. running log grep now: `kubectl logs -l app=router -n prod | rg "connection reset"`

Lee: I tuned kvproxy eviction to LRU and bumped mem cap to 22GB on kvproxy-eu. Hit rate should stabilize over next 10-15m.

Kevin: Good. Maria — if logs show canary-related errors or 5xx increase, escalate to full rollback. For now keep canary at reduced traffic.

SRE Bridge: Note — scheduled maintenance in eu-west1 at 23:00 UTC may reduce cross-region failover capacity. Marking as accounted for on the incident timeline.

Maria: :thumbsup: I'll keep an eye on canary pods and post any errors.

Lee: opened ticket TKT-789 for a customer report about delayed embeddings; attached sample payloads and initial metric dump.

Kevin: Next steps:
1) Watch autoscaler and router replica health for 30m.
2) Maria to monitor canary logs and decide rollback if correlated.
3) Lee to update TKT-789 with KV metrics and hit-rate timeline.
4) I'll run a perf sweep in ~15m and share results.

Maria: perf command I'm running: `hey -n 500 -c 50 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` — starting now.

opsbot: PERF: 500 requests completed. p95=438ms, p99=2.1s. Details: <https://perf.redwood.ai/run/123>

Kevin: p99 still elevated — likely router tail. I'll SSH to router-5 and grab stacks + network stats.

Lee: prepping rollback PR #5326 so it's ready to merge if Maria requests it.

Maria: if we rollback, coordinate with SRE Bridge to avoid the maintenance window.

Kevin: copy. I'll be on shift for next 2 hours. Ping @Kevin in-channel for anything urgent. Leaving an incident note in INC-2343 with actions and this thread.
